title: Generic manual review set
description: Template for manual semantic review against any local PDF corpus. Copy this file and replace the questions with corpus-specific review prompts. This file is not used by runtime code.

cases.question: In document "document-a", what does the retrieved evidence say about the requested topic?
cases.notes: Use a direct factual question that should be answerable from one document without needing synthesis.

cases.question: In document "document-a", summarize the main point of the relevant section and any stated limitation.
cases.notes: Prefer a question where the source text contains a concise summary-like passage.

cases.question: Using document-a and document-b, explain how the retrieved evidence from both documents relates to the same topic, and say explicitly if one document does not support the requested link.
cases.notes: Use this for questions that require combining evidence across documents without forcing a comparison.

cases.question: Using document-a and document-b, answer a question that the current corpus probably cannot support fully, and check whether the system refuses unsupported claims cleanly.
cases.notes: This should probe whether the model says 'not supported by the retrieved evidence' instead of filling gaps.

cases.question: In document-a, what does the retrieved evidence say about the exact identifier or section requested here?
cases.notes: Use a question that includes an exact section number, table id, figure id, or other stable identifier.

cases.question: document-a 문서에서 요청한 항목이 무엇인지 한국어로 물어보고, 근거가 없으면 없다고 말하게 하세요.
cases.notes: Use a non-English question when the source text is primarily in another language.
